magkano ang renta bawat araw o oras
how much to rent per day
how much ang rent per day

en: Rates depend on the vehicle and how long you plan to rent it. Which vehicle are you interested in, and for how many days or hours?
I can help with that. Tell me the vehicle type and rental duration so we can narrow down the rate.
fil: Depende ang rate sa sasakyan at kung ilang araw o oras mo itong gagamitin. Anong vehicle ang gusto mo?
Matutulungan kita. Sabihin mo lang kung anong sasakyan at gaano katagal ang rental.
taglish: Depende ang rate sa vehicle at rental duration. Anong unit at ilang days or hours?
Sure! Tell me the vehicle type and duration para mas ma-guide kita sa rate.

examples: is insurance included in the rental

responses.en: Yes, insurance is included in all vehicle rentals.
responses.fil: Oo, kasama ang insurance sa lahat ng nirentahang sasakyan.
responses.taglish: Yes, included ang insurance sa lahat ng vehicle rentals.

examples: how much is the security deposit

responses.en: Yes, there is a refundable security deposit of PHP 1,000.
responses.fil: Oo, may PHP 1,000 na refundable na security deposit.
responses.taglish: Yes, may refundable security deposit na PHP 1,000.

responses.en: Online payments are handled through PayMongo using GCash, Maya, or card. An approved walk-in payment may also be available for the remaining balance.
responses.fil: Ang online payment ay through PayMongo gamit ang GCash, Maya, o card. Maaari ring magkaroon ng approved walk-in payment para sa remaining balance.
responses.taglish: For online payment, PayMongo ang gamit with GCash, Maya, or card. May approved walk-in payment option din para sa remaining balance, kapag available.

examples: what are the requirements to rent a car
what documents are needed to rent

responses.en: You will need the required account and verification information, including a valid government ID and other documents requested by RentifyPro. Driver's License verification may be required for booking.
responses.fil: Kailangan ang account at verification requirements, kabilang ang valid government ID at iba pang dokumentong hinihingi ng RentifyPro. Maaaring kailanganin ang Driver's License para sa booking.
responses.taglish: You’ll need the required account and verification documents, including a valid government ID. Driver's License verification may also be required.

examples: what is the minimum age to rent
how old do I need to be
ilang taon minimum para mag rent

responses.en: The minimum age requirement is 18 years old.
responses.fil: Ang minimum na edad ay 18 taong gulang.
responses.taglish: Minimum age requirement is 18 years old para makapag-rent.

examples: do I need proof of address
need ko ba mag submit ng ID at address

responses.en: A valid government ID and any required verification documents may be requested. Check the verification step in your account for the exact requirements.
responses.fil: Maaaring kailanganin ang valid government ID at iba pang verification documents. I-check ang verification step sa account mo para sa eksaktong requirements.
responses.taglish: A valid government ID and other verification documents may be required. Check your account's verification step for the exact list.

examples: may available na kotse right now
available ba kayo na SUV or van
what cars can I book right now

responses.en: RentifyPro listings can include cars, motorcycles, vans, and trucks. For real-time availability, search by location, category, and your pickup and return schedule.
responses.fil: May cars, motorcycles, vans, at trucks sa RentifyPro. Para sa real-time availability, mag-search ayon sa location, category, at pickup at return schedule.
responses.taglish: May cars, motorcycles, vans, and trucks sa RentifyPro. For real-time availability, search using your location, vehicle type, and schedule.

responses.en: RentifyPro can have both automatic and manual vehicles. The exact transmission depends on the vehicle listing.
responses.fil: Maaaring may automatic at manual na sasakyan sa RentifyPro. Depende sa specific vehicle listing ang transmission.
responses.taglish: May automatic and manual vehicles, depende sa specific listing.

examples: should I return the vehicle with a full tank
kailangan bang ibalik na full tank ang sasakyan
do I need to return it full tank
dapat ba puno ang gasolina sa balik

responses.en: Check the vehicle listing and booking terms for the fuel-return requirement. If the booking requires a full tank, return it with the agreed fuel level.
responses.fil: I-check ang vehicle listing at booking terms para sa fuel-return requirement. Kung full tank ang requirement, ibalik ang sasakyan sa napagkasunduang fuel level.
responses.taglish: Check the listing and booking terms for the fuel rule. If full tank ang required, return it at the agreed fuel level.

examples: how many passengers can the vehicles accommodate
how many passengers can it carry

responses.en: Vehicle capacity depends on the specific listing. RentifyPro supports vehicles ranging from smaller cars to larger vans and trucks, so check the listing's seat capacity.
responses.fil: Depende sa specific listing ang passenger capacity. May iba't ibang vehicle sizes sa RentifyPro, kaya i-check ang seat capacity ng listing.
responses.taglish: Depende sa specific vehicle. Check the listing para sa exact passenger or seat capacity.

examples: can I choose a specific vehicle model
maaari bang pumili ng partikular na modelo
can I pick a specific model
can I choose a specific car model
may option ba to request a model

responses.en: Yes, you can choose a specific model when it is available. The exact unit still depends on the listing and owner's availability.
responses.fil: Oo, puwede kang pumili ng specific model kung available. Depende pa rin sa listing at availability ng owner ang exact unit.
responses.taglish: Yes, you can choose a specific model if available, but the exact unit depends on the owner's listing.

examples: how do I book a vehicle

responses.en: To book, verify your account, choose a vehicle, set your pickup and return schedule, review the booking details, and complete the required payment or verification steps.
responses.fil: Para mag-book, i-verify ang account, pumili ng sasakyan, itakda ang pickup at return schedule, i-review ang booking details, at kumpletuhin ang required payment o verification steps.
responses.taglish: To book, verify your account, choose a vehicle, set your schedule, review the details, then complete the required payment and verification steps.

examples: can I book for today agad

responses.en: Yes, same-day rental can be requested, subject to the vehicle's real-time availability and the owner's acceptance.
responses.fil: Oo, puwedeng mag-request ng same-day rental, depende sa real-time availability at approval ng owner.
responses.taglish: Yes, you can request same-day rental, pero depende sa availability at owner approval.

examples: is there an advance booking discount
may discount ba sa advance booking
do you give advance booking discounts
may discount ba kapag maagang booking
pwede discount if I book early

en: RentifyPro does not currently have a general advance-booking discount in this chatbot's fixed information. Check any active promo shown on the platform before booking.
fil: Wala akong nakalistang general advance-booking discount sa current chatbot information. I-check ang active promos na ipinapakita sa platform bago mag-book.
taglish: Wala akong fixed general advance-booking discount na ma-confirm ngayon. I-check ang active promos sa platform bago mag-book.

en: You can pay a 30% down payment or the full rental amount, depending on the booking option.
fil: Puwede kang magbayad ng 30% down payment o full amount, depende sa booking option.
taglish: Yes, may 30% down payment option o full payment, depende sa booking.

en: Yes. Online payments are handled through PayMongo using GCash, Maya, or card.
fil: Oo. Ang online payment ay through PayMongo gamit ang GCash, Maya, o card.
taglish: Yes. Online payment is through PayMongo using GCash, Maya, or card.

examples: can I pay the balance in person

en: An approved walk-in payment may be requested for the remaining balance. It still needs to be reviewed and confirmed.
fil: Maaaring mag-request ng approved walk-in payment para sa remaining balance. Kailangan pa itong ma-review at ma-confirm.
taglish: You may request an approved walk-in payment for the remaining balance, subject to review and confirmation.

en: You can track pending, confirmed, active, extended, completed, and cancelled bookings from your RentifyPro bookings area.
fil: Makikita mo sa RentifyPro bookings area ang pending, confirmed, active, extended, completed, at cancelled bookings.
taglish: You can track your pending, confirmed, active, extended, completed, or cancelled bookings in your bookings area.

en: You can submit a booking extension request. It depends on vehicle availability and the owner's approval.
fil: Puwede kang mag-submit ng booking extension request. Depende ito sa vehicle availability at approval ng owner.
taglish: You can request a booking extension, subject to availability and owner approval.

en: You can submit a cancellation request from the booking. Any applicable cancellation terms or charges will depend on that booking.
fil: Puwede kang mag-submit ng cancellation request mula sa booking. Depende sa booking ang applicable terms o charges.
taglish: You can request cancellation from the booking. Check the booking terms for any applicable rules or charges.

examples: can I rent with a driver

en: Some vehicle listings offer an optional driver. Check the listing details to see whether a driver is available.
fil: May ilang vehicle listings na may optional driver. I-check ang listing para makita kung available ito.
taglish: Some listings have an optional driver. Check the specific vehicle listing for availability.

en: RentifyPro supports cars, motorcycles, vans, and trucks, depending on the vehicles listed by owners.
fil: May cars, motorcycles, vans, at trucks sa RentifyPro, depende sa mga listing ng owners.
taglish: RentifyPro supports cars, motorcycles, vans, and trucks, depending on the available listings.

examples: how do I rate a vehicle

en: After a completed rental, you can rate and review the vehicle through RentifyPro.
fil: Pag completed na ang rental, puwede kang mag-rate at mag-review ng vehicle sa RentifyPro.
taglish: After a completed rental, you can rate and review the vehicle in RentifyPro.

examples: why did I get a notification

en: RentifyPro sends real-time notifications for important booking, payment, chat, and account activity. You can manage notification preferences in your account.
fil: Nagpapadala ang RentifyPro ng real-time notifications para sa booking, payment, chat, at account activity. Maaari mong i-manage ang preferences sa account.
taglish: RentifyPro sends real-time booking, payment, chat, and account notifications. You can manage your notification preferences in your account.

examples: how do I message the owner

en: You can communicate with the vehicle owner through RentifyPro's real-time messaging feature.
fil: Puwede kang makipag-chat sa vehicle owner gamit ang real-time messaging ng RentifyPro.
taglish: You can message the vehicle owner through RentifyPro's real-time chat.

en: RentifyPro uses email OTP, CAPTCHA, government ID checks, selfie-to-ID matching, liveness checks, role-based access, secure sessions, rate limiting, sanitization, audit logging, and protected KYC files.
fil: Gumagamit ang RentifyPro ng email OTP, CAPTCHA, government ID checks, selfie-to-ID matching, liveness checks, role-based access, secure sessions, at iba pang security controls.
taglish: RentifyPro uses email OTP, CAPTCHA, ID verification, selfie-to-ID matching, liveness checks, secure sessions, and other security controls.

notes: Expanded short inputs, casual conversation, Taglish, unclear/nonsense messages, acknowledgements, goodbyes, and help requests.
Added renter-facing intents for payments, booking status, extensions, cancellations, driver options, categories, reviews, notifications, messaging, and verification.
Natural responses intentionally vary so the chatbot does not repeat one robotic sentence.

Real-time availability, exact rates, booking status, payment status, penalties, extensions, and account-specific information should be retrieved from RentifyPro backend data rather than treated as fixed chatbot facts.
Validate all business-sensitive values against current RentifyPro rules before production deployment.
